problem: The public site exposed many capabilities and consultancy entry points but did not make Powerhouse legible as one scalable product platform quickly enough.
decision: Use a single platform narrative with Intelligence, Agents and Connect as the three public product lines and expose the closed-loop operating model plus existing-system compatibility directly after the hero.
prevention: Do not introduce standalone public capabilities that create a second product taxonomy.
Keep free entry and product demonstration visible before higher-touch sales.
Do not use unverified customer or scale claims as social proof.
root_cause: The existing site exposed many strong capabilities, demand-capture pages and consultancy entry points, but the homepage did not roll them up into one immediately legible scalable Powerhouse product architecture.
